audit.why: Levels 1-2 neither side has kill threat; 3-5 a charged Pyromania stun makes Annie's burst lethal; from 6 Nether Grasp out-locks her single engage and Malzahar's push out-farms her mana. 54.17% WR over 1200 games backs the late tilt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two flagged missing interactions absent from the page: Annie's stun (Pyromania proc / Tibbers) cancels Nether Grasp's channel, and Molten Shield (E, 10s CD) absorbs the burst window. breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; tradeGood/tradeBad are the pasted templates; 15+ fields misgender Annie.
